planes.label: AUDIO
planes.description: mic capture, playback, DSP, onset and pitch detection (native audio thread)

planes.label: SYNC
planes.description: shared clock, latency compensation, event stream (lock-free)

planes.label: MOTION
planes.description: animation drivers, scenes and rendering (UI thread + GPU)

planes.label: SHARED
planes.description: types, utilities and music-theory tables usable from any thread

planes.label: PLATFORM
planes.description: iOS and Android projects and native modules

planes.label: APP
planes.description: screens, navigation, lessons, scoring, progress, storage (JS thread)

modules.name: App.tsx
modules.purpose: Root component: safe-area provider, hidden status bar and the lesson screen, full screen in landscape.

modules.name: android
modules.purpose: Android app project: Gradle build, MainActivity, manifest and native Android code

modules.name: index.js
modules.purpose: Native entry point: registers the root App component with React Native.

modules.name: ios
modules.purpose: iOS app project: Xcode project, AppDelegate, Info.plist and native iOS code

modules.name: motion/scenes/PianoMaster
modules.purpose: The piano's single source of truth on screen, in two parts: CorePiano (the keyboard, any range: 48 keys by default, 88, 108 or any other) and CoreNotes (the sheet music above it). Also owns the key state (which keys are lit, in which role) that lessons and the mic write to on the UI thread.

modules.name: motion/scenes/PianoMaster/CoreNotes
modules.purpose: The staff of a lesson, drawn with Skia and SMuFL music fonts: the staff with its clef, time signature and rests, the QuarterNotes component (heads, stems and duration bars) and the playhead.

modules.name: motion/scenes/PianoMaster/CorePiano
modules.purpose: The piano keyboard at the bottom of PianoMaster: draws any range with Skia from one WhitePianoKey and one BlackPianoKey reused at every position, with the keybed, shadows, marker dots, note names and lit keys.

modules.name: motion/scenes/PianoMaster/CorePiano/BlackPianoKey
modules.purpose: The one black piano key: how it looks at rest and when lit. CorePiano draws it at every black key position.

modules.name: motion/scenes/PianoMaster/CorePiano/BlackPianoKeyShadows
modules.purpose: The shadows the black piano keys cast on the white keys, drawn for all black keys in one blurred layer.

modules.name: motion/scenes/PianoMaster/CorePiano/PianoFrameShadow
modules.purpose: The shadow the keyboard frame casts across the top of the white piano keys.

modules.name: motion/scenes/PianoMaster/CorePiano/PianoKeyLabel
modules.purpose: Note names on the piano keys: which keys show one and where (pure), and the system text that draws each name.

modules.name: motion/scenes/PianoMaster/CorePiano/PianoKeyMarker
modules.purpose: The dot under a marked piano key, such as middle C.

modules.name: motion/scenes/PianoMaster/CorePiano/PianoKeybed
modules.purpose: The keybed under the piano keys: the colour that shows through the gaps between the keys and the frame around them.

modules.name: motion/scenes/PianoMaster/CorePiano/WhitePianoKey
modules.purpose: The one white piano key: how it looks at rest and when lit. CorePiano draws it at every white key position.

modules.name: motion/scenes/PianoMaster/shared
modules.purpose: What more than one part of PianoMaster uses: the key state (which keys are lit, in which role), the lit-key colours, the key shape, gradients, picture recording and the look units.

modules.name: screens/LessonScreen
modules.purpose: The lesson screen: background, top bar, staff and keyboard laid out exactly as the reference design, full screen in landscape.

modules.name: shared/piano
modules.purpose: The piano model: notes, MIDI numbers, frequencies, keyboards of any size and key positions. Pure code, usable from any thread.

modules.name: shared/typography
modules.purpose: The system fonts (SF Pro and SF Pro Rounded) and their metrics, so text can be placed by its baseline. React Native font family for SF Pro Rounded on iOS.

rules.description: Screens never touch audio internals or native modules.
Features and audio are imported only through their public index.ts.
Motion code may not import features, screens, state stores or audio; it uses other motion code, sync/ and shared/.
Audio code has no UI imports.
Code that runs every frame in motion never hands work back to the JS thread.
Motion code takes durations and easing from tokens, not hard-coded numbers.
Code on the UI or audio thread never imports JS-thread code.
